description.zh:
亮灯频率，可选值：

- `ALWAYS`：持续亮灯

- `HEIGHT`：高频率亮灯

- `MIDDLE`：中频率亮灯

- `NORMAL`：正常频率亮灯。
description.en:
The LED blinking frequency. Valid values:

- `ALWAYS`: always on

- `HEIGHT`: high frequency

- `MIDDLE`: medium frequency

- `NORMAL`: normal frequency.

description.zh:
亮灯颜色，可选值：

- `GREEN`：绿色

- `RED`：红色

- `BLUE`：蓝色

- `OFF`：关闭。
description.en:
The LED color. Valid values:

- `GREEN`: green

- `RED`: red

- `BLUE`: blue

- `OFF`: off.

description.zh: 亮灯时长，单位：s，取值大于1。
description.en: The duration for which the LED stays on. Unit: seconds. The value must be greater than 1.

description.zh: 门店ID或商家自定义门店ID。
description.en: The store ID or merchant-defined custom store ID.

title.en: Control the LED light of an ESL
